annotation.title_clean: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government (OMB Memorandum M-25-22)
annotation.title_en: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government (OMB Memorandum M-25-22)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President (Russell T. Vought, Director)
annotation.summary_en: OMB Memorandum M-25-22 (April 2025) directs US federal agencies on acquiring AI systems, replacing M-24-18. It emphasizes competitive markets, avoiding vendor lock-in, data portability, performance and risk tracking (including high-impact AI), and cross-functional teams across the acquisition lifecycle. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Rescinds and replaces OMB M-24-18 on responsible AI acquisition.
Applies to contracts from solicitations issued 180 days after issuance; excludes the Intelligence Community.
Agencies must convene cross-functional teams and identify risks, including high-impact AI use cases.
Promotes competition, interoperability, data portability and avoiding vendor lock-in.
Requires standardized treatment of data ownership and IP rights; GSA to produce a procurement guide and repository.
